what: Pressing the menu button raises a layer covering the screen (white 16% scrim + drawer panel) and turns it on over .4s after .04s. The panel follows .24s later, entering from transparent and 300px to the side over .3s together — a Studio modal drawer. Closing via the close button, scrim or Esc slides the panel out and turns the layer off over .4s, and once fully off the layer is removed and focus returns to the button that opened it.

options.side: If right, it comes in from the right, if top, it drops from the top (default left)
options.shift: Distance the panel slides in (px), default 300
options.wait: Delay before the layers start turning on after pressing (sec), default .04
options.fade: Duration of layers turning on and off (sec), default .4
options.delay: Delay (sec) before the panel starts moving after the press, default .24 — 0 moves it together with the layer
options.[data-fx-part=toggle]: Open button (multiple allowed) — element gets is-open when opened
options.[data-fx-part=layer]: Fixed layer holding the mask and panels — when closed it is detached from the document (attached on open, like the original Studio modal)
options.[data-fx-part=lay]: Backdrop (optional, button recommended) — click to close. Background is --kf-surface at 16%
options.[data-fx-part=panel]: Incoming panel — position, size, corners and background are set by the consumer’s css
options.[data-fx-part=close]: Close button (optional) — focus moves here when opened
options.narrow-side: Side used on narrow screens (narrow-at or below) — top·right·left, default side
options.narrow-shift: Distance pushed in on narrow screens (px), default is shift
options.look: If slide, the panel only slides without turning transparent (layers are revealed as they switch on)
options.--fx-panel-ease: Curve for the panel only (css variable — set on the layer), default --fx-ease

use: …
note: The original Studio attaches a modal on click (width and height from 0 to screen size), releases the wrapper and overlay opacity over .4s, and releases the panel’s appear (opacity 0 · translate -300px 0) .3s and .2s later — we measured the original and the copy together with motion-probe to match the delays. Closing wasn’t measured in the original, so it runs in reverse with the same durations
